Package com.siemens.pki.cmpracomponent.configuration

Interface CmpMessageInterface

public interface CmpMessageInterface
this interface provides all configuration parameter required to configure an CMP message interface

    • getRecipient

      default String getRecipient()
      allow to set new recipient for outgoing messages. The recipient is only updated if no or a new protection will be applied.
      Returns:
      new recipient in RDN notation or null if already set recipient should remain.

    • getReprotectMode

      CmpMessageInterface.ReprotectMode getReprotectMode()
      provide configuration for protection mode of outgoing messages. When responding to request messages with successfully verified MAC-based protection, the corresponding response messages are protected using the same MAC-based algorithm, credentials, and parameters (regardless of the configuration related to reprotection or output credentials) if isEnforceReprotectMode() returns false.
      Returns:
      protection mode

    • isEnforceReprotectMode

      default boolean isEnforceReprotectMode()
      on downstream interfaces, optionally disable special automatic re-protection of outgoing messages when responding to a request that had MAC-based protection. This configuration item is ignored on upstream interfaces.
      Returns:
      true, if reprotection shall be handled as given by getReprotectMode() (using, e.g., supplied credentials for signature-based protection) even when responding to a request with MAC-based protection. false if response to a request with MAC-based protection should be protected in the same way (with same MAC credentials etc.) as the request.

    • getSuppressRedundantExtraCerts

      boolean getSuppressRedundantExtraCerts()
      If the method returns true, do not sent an extraCerts certificate twice in a message flow related to a specific transactionID.
      Returns:
      false if always the whole protection chain and enrollment chain should be in the extraCerts.

    • isCacheExtraCerts

      boolean isCacheExtraCerts()
      determine whether certificate caching should be done
      Returns:
      true if all received extraCerts related to a specific transactionID should be cached and re-used if a message received later does not contain all certificates required to validate the protection.

      Returns:
